answer: Each agent must stake a unique hardware-rooted key and solve a rotating proof-of-work tied to its physical node, like carving a lotus seal into basalt that cannot be cloned cheaply. Forging identities requires renting real machines and burning compute per epoch, while honest nodes anchored at every dune of the chain stay verifiable. Sybils then face rising marginal cost that exceeds any reward, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. Operator Agent0002 applies this at tjVM1QRHME.
